d: Deep magenta, straight hair with long bangs falls past the shoulders. Sharp, narrow eyes are a matching deep magenta, set in a mature face of a young adult with a slim build. The attire consists of a white military-style dress with red accents, a red necktie, and a white officer's cap with a black visor, all layered under a voluminous white cape with white fur trim, a grey lining, and black straps. Accessories include black gloves, a white belt with a silver buckle, and black lace-up thigh-high boots.
